how_opened: June 24 board decision launched broad preliminary outreach; CSC contacted by June 28.
who_was_in: 50 outreach prospects: 15 strategic (A, CSC/Pamplona, 13 others) and 35 financial (B, C, 33 others). Initial-stage access individually dated for CSC/Pamplona, B and C; 16 other financial NDA/information recipients have uncertain dates. Party A already live by its June 21 bid, but not admitted to confidential review until August 5. Twenty eventual NDA signers is not July 23 eligibility.
bids_received: 3: CSC/Pamplona (Strategic), Party B and Party C (Financial). A’s June 21 bid is round 0 and remained under consideration; no new round 1 A bid. No other-scope bids.
how_it_ended: July 25: B, C and CSC/Pamplona advanced, A conditionally admitted on an NDA. B and C missed July 23 but continued; C revised in writing July 25. Sixteen anonymous financial signers inferred excluded by August 27; precise earlier eligibility/exit timing unresolved (Q5).

how_opened: July 25 selection for management meetings, staged information and revised offers.
who_was_in: 3 admitted at opening: CSC/Pamplona (Strategic), B and C (Financial). A (Strategic) eligible conditionally, admitted August 5. Then 4 admitted, 2 Strategic + 2 Financial. At opening, 4 known live units including A, plus up to 16 anonymous financial entrants with uncertain timing; those 16 not shown admitted and inferred excluded by August 27. No continuing partial alternative.
bids_received: 4: CSC/Pamplona, Party A, Party B and Party C. No other-scope bids.
bidders_bid: csc/pamplona; party a; party b; party c
how_it_ended: All four invited to final indications September 11. A and C missed September 9 but bid September 10 and continued; C responded orally despite the written request. No rival eliminated among these four.

how_opened: September 11 calls requested final indications by September 18.
who_was_in: 4 admitted/live: CSC/Pamplona and Party A (2 Strategic); Party B and Party C (2 Financial). No other bidder carried forward. C then did not submit; A and B displaced by September 24 exclusivity. CSC/Pamplona alone through signing.
bids_received: 3: CSC/Pamplona, Party A and Party B. Later CSC funding/liability revisions count once for bidder totals. No other-scope bids.
how_it_ended: C did not submit and exits by September 18. Target selected CSC/Pamplona for $21.25 counter; September 24 exclusivity excludes A/B. Exclusivity extended October 12; signed October 14. No missed-deadline bidder continued in this round.
